A '''Mon Calamari Shell Horn''' was a wind [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument made from a large conch that could be found in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Trivia" /> The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Cal]] military leaders and [[Mon Calamari Knights/Legends|Mon Calamari Knights]]<ref name="CW5">{{CW|5}}</ref> used such musical shells to issue orders on the battlefield. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]] blew the Shell Horn to rally his forces while fighting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]].<ref name="TCW402">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref> The instruments were also used by shell horn [[Band/Legends|bands]]. Several such bands from Dac were popular during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
